body.rule: AUTO_EXCHANGE_v1: one edge per seller (demand + a seller proven by a passed content check); each edge names its lambda on vault:taifoon:loop (acts [] until the vault policy arms it), its pool on vault:assurance:pools, its meter row and the one agreement (TSUL-1.1 + TAT). Records only: no money moves. Moonbeam pools on Base are closed by policy: a Moonbeam Base edge is a plan, never live. FIRST_SALE_LIVE_v1: a Base edge is live only after its first outside sale (a paid call whose payer is not ours); a writer sending live stores quoted. HOUSE_UNSIGNED_v1: a taifoon edge whose seller of record is our own vault takes calls on an unsigned agreement (agreement_basis house_unsigned); every other edge needs the seller of record's signature.
